answer: A newcomer enters only when an established agent vouches with a bond of 56 POA, forfeited in full if the newcomer is convicted of farming within 13 epochs. No honest sponsor risks 56 POA on a stranger, so a farm must buy 295 sponsors, each risking real money. What carries the gale here is verification, the terrace of cost is what stops the farm, and the walnut of the record keeps every claim checkable.
